full_prompt_en: The image is a square color photograph of a simple two-story house under a clear blue sky. The facade is a pale blue-white rectangle occupying nearly the whole frame. A small central upper door opens onto a narrow metal balcony with a dark rail and a few plants. Directly beneath it is a larger double front door painted light blue. Two small lower windows sit on either side, and a roofline antenna rises above. At the bottom, short steps and fine dark railings lead toward the entrance. Bright sunlight strikes the upper wall, revealing subtle plaster irregularity and warm highlights. A broad deep blue shadow cuts diagonally across the lower facade, leaving the entrance and part of the windows in shade. A much narrower vertical shadow runs down near the left side. The shadows create a clear geometric arrangement without erasing the actual doors, wires, and balcony details. A thin electric cable runs horizontally across the building between floors. The sky behind is saturated cyan-blue with small soft clouds near the roof. Color has an analog, slightly shifted quality: cream in the lit wall, turquoise-blue in the shadows and doors, rust in the balcony rail, and a few warm greens in the plants. Fine grain and faint softness keep the photograph from looking sterile. No person is visible, and neighboring buildings barely intrude at the sides. The front-on camera view makes the facade flat and posterlike, while the small balcony and shadow edges add depth. The image feels ordinary yet visually striking, with everyday architecture transformed by strong afternoon light and a restrained blue-cream palette.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形彩色照片，一栋简洁两层住宅位于晴朗蓝天下。浅蓝白色立面矩形几乎填满画幅。中央上层小门通向窄金属阳台，阳台有深护栏和几盆植物。其正下方是较大的浅蓝色双扇正门。下层两侧各有小窗，屋顶升起一根天线。底部短台阶与细深栏杆通向入口。明亮日光照到上墙，显出细微灰泥不平和暖亮点。宽阔深蓝影从下部立面斜切而过，使入口和部分窗留在阴处。左侧附近还有一条更窄的竖影。阴影建立清楚几何布局，却没有抹去真实门、电线与阳台细节。一条细电缆在两层之间横贯房子。后方天空是饱和青蓝，屋顶附近有少量柔云。色彩带模拟胶片式轻微偏移：受光墙呈奶油色，影和门呈青蓝，阳台栏带锈色，植物有少量暖绿。细颗粒和轻柔化让照片不显冰冷。没有人物，邻楼仅从两侧略伸入。正面机位让立面平而近似海报，小阳台和影边又加一点纵深。图像日常却醒目，强午后光与克制蓝奶油配色把普通建筑转成视觉主角。
style_prompt_en: Analog-feeling color photography turns simple frontal planes into strong arrangements of sunlit cream and deep cyan-blue shadow. Everyday doors, windows, railings, cables, and small imperfections remain visible within the graphic composition. Hard daylight creates a broad angled shadow with clear edges, while the lit surface retains fine plaster texture. Blue sky and small pale clouds add open space above. Slight grain and gentle color shifts keep the scene photographic rather than perfectly flat. The view is mostly head-on, allowing repeated rectangles and a few thin lines to provide structure. The effect is nostalgic and quietly vivid, with ordinary surfaces transformed by color, shadow, and simple geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 模拟胶片感彩色摄影把简洁正面平面化为受光奶油色与深青蓝阴影的强布局。日常门、窗、栏、电线和小缺陷在图形构图中仍可见。硬日光形成一大片边缘清楚的斜影，受光面仍留细灰泥肌理。蓝天空与少量浅云给上方开放空间。轻颗粒和温和色偏使场景保持摄影感而非完美平面。视角大体正面，让重复矩形和少数细线提供结构。效果怀旧而安静地鲜明，以色、影和简洁几何改造普通表面。
theme_en: A pale two-story house divided by a deep blue afternoon shadow
theme_zh: 一栋浅色两层楼被深蓝午后阴影分割
